text: with three races left in the Apex energy
summer series presented by Boon Chrysler
Dodge Jeep and RAM we'll be heading to
the New Hampshire Motor Speedway for 150
laps let's hop straight into
qualifying before you get up to speed
give yourself some time to build heat in
your brakes without scrubbing your tires
weave back and forth and Alternate
between the gas and brake with each
swerve once you reach turn three start
getting up to speed and begin your first
lap as always you'll want to use your
first lap as your warm-up lap run a bit
deeper into the corners give it some
extra break and get yourself ready to
Arc out of turn four to take the White
Flag heading into turn one aim for the
first row of dotted weight lines on the
inside may be tempting to aim for the
flat but it'll shoot you up the
racetrack in a hurry so try to hook the
white line through the corner and let
the car roll through the center give it
a bit of gas to get the back end rotated
before easing back onto the throttle on
exit once you make your run down the
backstretch break hard and enter turn
three just as you did in turn one I slid
up the track a bit here but you can
compensate for that by aiming further
down the track on exit watch out for the
bumps in the center of the corner and
ease back on the throttle as you Arc out
towards the wall to finish your lap
we're back to having two sets of tires
in the pits this week so as tempting as
it may be to fire off early in the race
I would strongly advise against it your
best bet would be to run at the bottom
of the banked portion of the track and
give the tires time to heat up if you
can hook the white lines with your left
front and avoid kicking the back end out
on exit you'll have a solid shot at
wearing your right side tires
evenly with that in mind the track will
heat up as the race goes on so you may
be able to find extra speed running a
lane or two higher if you dime in the
corner properly using the dotted white
lines as a reference point you may be
able to make it work but it will have an
additional effect on your right rear
tire so tread
lightly as much as I would recommend not
doing this you can use the flat portion
of the track to gain time on Entry but
if you don't get the car rotated you
will slide up the track ruin your right
front tire and potentially cause a wreck
if you want to give it a shot in a pack
boot up the AI and set the skill spread
between 70 and
85% if you can make use of your
resources maintain your tires and keep
yourself out of trouble you'll find
yourself in a great position at the end
of the race we only have three of them
left in the slingshot Racing League so
let's go out with the bang good luck
